nodes.label: Evaluation Metrics for RAG Systems
nodes.description: Overview of metrics used to evaluate Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, from traditional to RAG-specific approaches.

nodes.label: Traditional Evaluation Metrics
nodes.description: Metrics designed for fixed reference answers, primarily measuring text overlap.

nodes.label: BLEU (Bilingual Evaluation Understudy)
nodes.description: Measures n-gram overlap between generated and reference text, includes a brevity penalty.

nodes.label: ROUGE (Recall-Oriented Understudy for Gisting Evaluation)
nodes.description: Focuses on recall, measuring how much core information from the reference is in the output, ideal for summarization.

nodes.label: F1 Score
nodes.description: Harmonic mean of precision and recall, effective for tasks prioritizing specific facts or entities.

nodes.label: Need for RAG-Specific Metrics
nodes.description: Explanation of why traditional metrics are insufficient for RAG systems.

nodes.label: RAG System Operation
nodes.description: RAG systems operate in two stages: retrieval and generation.

nodes.label: Limitations of Traditional Metrics
nodes.description: Traditional metrics fail to measure the quality of RAG's specific retrieval and generation stages.

nodes.label: Key RAG Evaluation Metrics
nodes.description: Metrics designed to evaluate both information retrieval and synthesis in RAG systems.

nodes.label: Context Precision
nodes.description: Measures how much of the retrieved information is relevant to the user query.

nodes.label: Context Recall
nodes.description: Measures the retriever’s ability to pull all necessary information from the database.

nodes.label: Answer Relevance
nodes.description: Assesses if the generated answer directly addresses the user's intent using embeddings.

nodes.label: Faithfulness
nodes.description: Ensures the answer is strictly grounded in the retrieved context, preventing hallucinations.

nodes.label: Groundedness
nodes.description: Evaluates if the answer relies on the retrieved documents rather than the model's internal memory.

nodes.label: Modern Evaluation Workflow
nodes.description: New approaches and frameworks for evaluating RAG systems.

nodes.label: LLM-as-a-Judge
nodes.description: Using a large language model to act as an evaluator, mimicking human judgment for semantic understanding.

nodes.label: RAGAS (RAG Assessment)
nodes.description: An open-source framework that automates the calculation of RAG-specific metrics using embeddings and LLM-based scoring.
